recommendations: Hold current prices and descriptions for the newest September releases for another equal observation window.

At the next audit, compare each September release on the same 14-day post-submission window and separate paperback, eBook and KENP.
Treat PMP's 10 KENP pages as early engagement, not as validated product-market fit.
Review Solar's paperback-only architecture only if that absence was not intentional; no KDP change is authorized by this audit.
